title: Audit a Shopping Journey with TalkBack
prompt: Make product browsing, variant selection, adding to basket, error recovery, and checkout summary operable and understandable through semantics and TalkBack.
successCriteria: Every control has meaningful role, state, and action.
Focus order and announcements support the full task.
Automated checks and a manual TalkBack script both pass.
hints: Write down the ownership and failure contract before choosing library APIs.
Prove one adverse or lifecycle case before improving presentation.

starterCode.code: @Composable fun ProductCard(product: ProductUi, onAdd: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier)

solutionOutline: Model immutable inputs, outputs, events, and failures at the boundary.
Implement the smallest correct path and verify every success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic state or protocol tests.
Inspect the relevant accessibility, lifecycle, concurrency, or network boundary.
